boot.lore.uncommon: Walks home by itself from any field, always by the muddiest route. Then waits on the doormat looking innocent.
boot.lore.rare: Leaves muddy footprints that keep walking after it stops. They have reached the bathroom twice and the loft once.
boot.lore.epic: Stamped once on the school field and every puddle in town jumped out of its hole. The lollipop lady is still mopping.
boot.lore.legendary: Walked a thousand miles home after being left at a campsite. Its first act was to kick mud on whoever forgot it.

dress.lore.rare: Grows a new pocket wherever one is needed. Grandma has found forty sweets in it and a lost hamster.
dress.lore.epic: Spun so fast at the wedding that it took off like a helicopter. The bouquet is still on the town hall roof.
dress.lore.legendary: Spun so beautifully at the ball that the clock stopped to watch. The party got an extra hour, and still ran out of cake.

x_balaclava.lore.rare: Knits a new hole wherever you need to scratch. By lunchtime it is mostly holes and its owner is mostly face.
x_balaclava.lore.epic: Stretched over a whole village of snowmen to keep them cosy. By lunch the village was one big woolly puddle.
x_balaclava.lore.legendary: Kept a mountain top so warm that it stopped snowing there. Skiers now queue at the summit in shorts.

x_bandana.lore.rare: Ties itself over the face of anyone who sneezes nearby. The library now looks like a gang of very polite outlaws.
x_bandana.lore.epic: Flapped so hard on a windy hill that it whipped up a dust storm. The whole village now sneezes in the same direction.
x_bandana.lore.legendary: Lassoed a runaway cattle stampede with one corner. The cows agreed to walk home if it promised to stop flapping.

i_bathing_cap.lore.rare: Squeaks like a dolphin underwater. The lifeguard has closed the pool twice to look for it.
i_bathing_cap.lore.epic: Stuck to the bottom of the pool so hard that it pulled the plug out. The swimming club finished the race on the grass.
i_bathing_cap.lore.legendary: Swam across the sea by itself and reached the far side first. Its swimmer arrived an hour later, cold and very cross.

i_bearskin.lore.rare: Growls like a real bear whenever a tourist pulls a face. The ice-cream van now parks round the corner.
i_bearskin.lore.epic: Grew so tall overnight that the guard behind it could not see. He marched straight into the palace pond, still in step.
i_bearskin.lore.legendary: Stood so still for so long that a family of birds moved in on top. The guards now change shifts on tiptoe.

x_beret.lore.rare: Paints a tiny moustache on every portrait it walks past. The art gallery has stopped letting it in.
x_beret.lore.epic: Tilted so far over one ear that the whole café tilted with it. Every croissant slid off the tables and into the river.
x_beret.lore.legendary: Painted a sunset so real that the actual sun went down early to compare. The whole town had dinner at four.

x_bowler_hat.lore.rare: Tips itself to every single person in the street. Its owner arrives at work an hour late with a very sore neck.
x_bowler_hat.lore.epic: Lifted off in a gust and every bowler in town followed like a flock of birds. The pigeons have filed a complaint.
x_bowler_hat.lore.legendary: Caught the morning train without its owner and went to work alone. It now has a desk, a name badge and the window seat.

x_bucket_hat.lore.rare: Holds a whole bucket of rain on its brim and tips it over whoever laughs at it. The campsite has run out of dry people.
x_bucket_hat.lore.epic: Flipped over at the festival and was used as a real bucket. It carried enough mud to build a second stage.
x_bucket_hat.lore.legendary: Collected so much rain at one festival that it became a pond. A family of ducks moved in and will not leave.

x_crown.names.legendary: The Crown That Crowned a Cat
x_crown.lore.rare: Makes whoever wears it give silly royal orders. Grandpa wore it for ten minutes and banned Tuesdays.
x_crown.lore.epic: Rolled off during the parade and down the hill like a golden wheel. Half the town chased it and the parade ended at the bakery.
x_crown.lore.legendary: Was put on the palace cat by mistake. The cat has now ruled for nine years and has only ever banned baths.

x_earmuffs.lore.common: Muffles every question you are asked, so you answer the wrong one all day.
x_earmuffs.lore.rare: Picks up the radio through its fluff. Plays the football scores into your ears during the maths test.
x_earmuffs.lore.epic: Clamped itself over the school fire alarm. The whole school had a lovely quiet fire drill that nobody knew about.
x_earmuffs.lore.legendary: Sat on top of a thundercloud and muffled the whole storm. The cloud now only rains in whispers.

x_fedora.lore.rare: Solves mysteries nobody asked about. Has told the whole street exactly who leaves the bin lid open.
x_fedora.lore.epic: Pulled its brim so low over the town that it was night by lunchtime. The owls went to work early.
x_fedora.lore.legendary: Solved the greatest mystery in the city: who keeps moving the garden gnomes. They had gone on holiday and sent postcards.

hat.lore.epic: Pulled a rabbit out of itself at a birthday party, then another, then forty. The garden is now mostly rabbits.
hat.lore.legendary: Blew off one windy morning and landed on every head in town in turn. By night it had been worn by four thousand people and a horse.

x_headband.lore.rare: Saves up a whole match of sweat and wrings it out over the umpire. The tennis club now hands out umbrellas.
x_headband.lore.epic: Was stretched across the finish line at sports day and pinged the winner back to the start. He has now won twice.
x_headband.lore.legendary: Kept one runner's hair out of his eyes for a whole marathon. He ran so straight that he finished in the next town.

i_mortarboard.lore.epic: Was thrown so high at graduation that it landed on a passing plane. It has since graduated in four more countries.
i_mortarboard.lore.legendary: Has sat through so many speeches that it now gives them. Last year it spoke for six hours and gave itself a degree in snoring.

i_shower_cap.lore.rare: Puffs up with steam until it floats off out of the window. The neighbours keep bringing it back, slightly damp.
i_shower_cap.lore.epic: Blew up so big in the hotel steam room that it covered every guest like a tent. Nobody got wet, and nobody found the door.
i_shower_cap.lore.legendary: Stayed on through a storm at sea, a waterfall and a car wash. The curls underneath have never felt a single raindrop.

i_ski_mask.lore.rare: Fogs up every pair of goggles it gets near. The ski instructor has taught a whole lesson to a tree.
i_ski_mask.lore.epic: Breathed out so much warm air on the slope that the snow melted into a river. The ski school finished the day in boats.
i_ski_mask.lore.legendary: Raced an avalanche down the mountain and won by a nose. The avalanche wants a rematch and is still climbing back up.

x_sun_hat.lore.rare: Follows the sun round the garden by itself, dragging its owner along. Grandpa has been round the house nine times today.
x_sun_hat.lore.epic: Opened its brim so wide on the beach that it shaded the whole sea. The fish asked for the sun back by teatime.
x_sun_hat.lore.legendary: Blocked the sun for a whole summer so its owner never got a freckle. The tomatoes went on strike.

x_tiara.lore.rare: Makes whoever wears it wave like royalty at everything. Dad waved at the bin lorry for twenty minutes.
x_tiara.lore.legendary: Was worn by a pigeon for a whole year after a ball. The pigeon now refuses crumbs unless they come on a plate.

x_visor.lore.rare: Bounces sunlight into the other player's eyes at exactly the wrong moment. The umpire has asked it to face the wall.
x_visor.lore.epic: Shaded centre court so well that the grass thought it was night and went to sleep. The final was played in the car park.
x_visor.lore.legendary: Has watched so many finals that it now calls the lines itself. It is never wrong, and the umpire has taken up knitting.

x_wig_hair.lore.rare: Grows a new hairstyle every night. Monday a beehive, Tuesday a quiff, Wednesday something the cat tried to adopt.
x_wig_hair.lore.epic: Grew so big in the final scene that the actors got lost in its curls. The curtain came down so they could be combed out.
x_wig_hair.lore.legendary: Played every part in one night: king, queen, villain and horse. It took eleven bows and asked for a twelfth.

helmet.lore.rare: Bounces off everything twice as hard as it hits it. Its owner headed a football into the next town.
helmet.lore.epic: Bumped a doorframe so hard that the whole building site wobbled. The crane driver now wears two helmets.
helmet.lore.legendary: Took a falling piano on the head and played a perfect note. Its owner walked away humming.

jacket.lore.rare: Takes itself off the hook and goes to school without you. Its marks are now better than yours.
jacket.lore.epic: Turned its collar up so high that it hid the whole office. Everyone went home early because nobody could find the boss.
jacket.lore.legendary: Has an inside pocket so deep that the family moved in. Grandma has the room by the zip and complains of draughts.

jeans.lore.rare: Rips at the knee whenever a teacher looks. The rip then grows a second knee, which also wants to be fashionable.
jeans.lore.epic: Turned the washing machine blue, then the bathroom, then the dog. The whole house now matches the jeans.
jeans.lore.legendary: Went so long without a wash that they now stand in the corner on their own. Last week they went to the shops alone.

scarf.lore.rare: Wraps itself round anyone who says they are cold and will not let go until spring. The postman is still wearing it.
scarf.lore.epic: Soaked up the whole paddling pool in one go, then the bath. The garden hose is now afraid of it.
scarf.lore.legendary: Wrapped the town clock tower one winter to keep it warm. The clock got so cosy it fell asleep, and nobody was late for a month.

i_academic_gown.lore.common: Flaps its huge sleeves whenever its owner talks, and the pigeons outside flap back.
i_academic_gown.lore.epic: Spread its sleeves in a gust and lifted the whole graduating class off the lawn. They landed in the library and stayed to study.
i_academic_gown.lore.legendary: Has worn so many professors that it now gives the lectures itself. Nobody noticed, except that the jokes got better.

i_bib.lore.rare: Catches flying food and flings it straight back. The highchair has won every food fight since.
i_bib.lore.epic: Stretched out to catch a whole party's spaghetti at once. The ceiling stayed clean, and the dog has never forgiven it.
i_bib.lore.legendary: Caught every crumb a baby dropped for two whole years. The floor has never needed sweeping and the dog had to get a job.

i_brassiere.lore.rare: Hooks itself onto anything that passes the washing line. So far it has caught a kite, a pigeon and next door's cat.
i_brassiere.lore.legendary: Blew off the line in a gale and flew all day like a kite with two sails. It landed folded, in the right drawer.

i_breastplate.lore.uncommon: Gets so hot in the sun that the knight fries his breakfast egg on it.
i_breastplate.lore.epic: Clanged so loudly when its knight fell off his horse that the drawbridge slammed shut. The knights have been stuck outside since Tuesday.
i_breastplate.lore.legendary: Bounced a dragon's sneeze straight back up its nose. The dragon has carried a hanky ever since.

i_chain_mail.lore.uncommon: Catches every crumb in its rings. A knight can eat breakfast out of it at lunchtime.
i_chain_mail.lore.epic: Shook itself like a wet dog after the rain and soaked every knight at the feast. The king's soup is now mostly puddle.
i_chain_mail.lore.legendary: Was taken apart ring by ring by a magpie and rebuilt as a nest. The magpie now goes jousting on Saturdays.

i_cuirass.lore.uncommon: Is curved so smoothly that the castle cats use it as a slide.
i_cuirass.lore.epic: Caught the midday sun and beamed it across the castle. The cook's pies baked themselves before anyone lit the oven.

i_diaper.lore.rare: Fills with so much air that the baby floats. Bath time now needs a lifeguard and a rubber duck on patrol.
i_diaper.lore.legendary: Kept a baby dry on a sailing trip all the way round the world. The baby came home and asked for a boat of its own.

i_maillot.lore.common: Twists its straps into a knot every time you climb out of the pool.
i_maillot.lore.rare: Swims faster than its swimmer and drags her down the lane. She has won races she never meant to enter.
i_maillot.lore.epic: Stretched across the whole pool like a lane rope. The swimmers bounced off it all afternoon and nobody finished.
i_maillot.lore.legendary: Swam so many lengths in one summer that the pool got shorter. The council had to repaint the lines.

i_pajama.lore.rare: Puts anyone who touches it to sleep in ten seconds. The doctor came round and is still snoring on the sofa.
i_pajama.lore.epic: Started a pillow fight so big that the feathers came down as snow. The school closed for a snow day.
i_pajama.lore.legendary: Has heard every secret whispered at a hundred sleepovers. It now runs the most-read newspaper in the street.

i_sarong.lore.rare: Catches the breeze like a sail and drags its wearer down the beach. She got to the ice-cream van first, backwards.
i_sarong.lore.epic: Unfolded on the windy beach until it covered the whole shore. The crabs held a party underneath.
i_sarong.lore.legendary: Was tied to a mast when the sail tore and blew a fishing boat all the way home. The fish were very disappointed.

i_swimming_trunks.lore.uncommon: Dries in the sun in four seconds flat, just in time to be pushed back into the pool.
i_swimming_trunks.lore.epic: Ballooned up with air and floated the whole family across the lake. Dad steered with his feet.
i_swimming_trunks.lore.legendary: Jumped off the top board and did so many flips that it landed tomorrow. Its owner had to wait a day to get dressed.

shirt.lore.epic: Untucked itself in the school photo and every shirt in the row did the same. The picture is now mostly elbows.
shirt.lore.legendary: Was worn so often that it learned to fold itself. It now does the whole family's ironing, and complains.

i_theater_curtain.lore.epic: Came down in the middle of the play and refused to go back up. The audience watched it for an hour and clapped.
i_theater_curtain.lore.legendary: Upstaged a famous actor by closing on him mid-song. The audience loved it, and the curtain now has its own dressing room.

i_velvet.lore.legendary: Was so soft that a whole castle fell asleep on it for a hundred years. The dragon outside gave up and opened a café.

i_vestment.lore.common: Has so much gold thread that it sets off the metal detector at every door.
i_vestment.lore.rare: Is so stiff with embroidery that it stands up on its own. It has been mistaken for its wearer twice.
i_vestment.lore.epic: Swept down the town hall steps with a train so long that it reached the bus stop. Two buses waited to let it pass.
i_vestment.lore.legendary: Shone with so much gold that a dragon tried to sleep on it. The dragon now has a very sparkly back and a sore neck.

i_wool.lore.uncommon: Keeps unrolling across the floor to see where it ends. It always ends under the fridge.
i_wool.lore.rare: Knits itself into a jumper overnight, always with one arm too long. The cat wears the spare.
i_wool.lore.legendary: Was rolled out so far by the kitten that it reached the next country. The kitten came home a year later with a passport.

x_gloves_pair.lore.rare: Points at whatever its owner is secretly thinking about. It pointed at the cake all through the wedding speeches.
x_gloves_pair.lore.legendary: Stayed together as a pair for twenty years. Every lost glove in town now writes to it for advice.

x_mittens_pair.lore.epic: Got so warm in the snow fight that the whole street melted. The snowmen are now puddles with carrot noses.
x_mittens_pair.lore.legendary: Held hands with a snowman all winter so it would not feel lonely. In spring the snowman left it a carrot.

x_socks_pair.names.legendary: Sir Sockington, Star of the Show
x_socks_pair.lore.epic: Slid down the stairs like a sledge and kept going out of the front door. It was found three streets away, still sliding.
x_socks_pair.lore.legendary: Was worn as a puppet and gave such a speech that the audience cried. It now has an agent and an understudy sock.

x_bow.lore.rare: Ties itself onto anything that stays still for a minute. Grandpa woke up from his nap gift-wrapped.
x_bow.lore.epic: Tied the whole birthday party into one enormous present. Nobody got out until the birthday girl pulled one end.
x_bow.lore.legendary: Tied itself round the whole town on a birthday morning. The mayor had to unwrap the high street before the shops could open.

tie.lore.epic: Was knotted so tight that the whole office held its breath. The meeting finished in two minutes and everyone went home early.
tie.lore.legendary: Was tied in a knot so clever that nobody could undo it for forty years. Grandad now sleeps in it and calls it a scarf.

x_ankle_boot.lore.epic: Clicked down the high street so steadily that every clock in town set itself by it. The town now wakes when it walks.
x_ankle_boot.lore.legendary: Strutted through the city so stylishly that the statues turned to look. One of them has not turned back since.

x_badge.names.legendary: The Badge That Promoted a Goat
x_badge.lore.rare: Turns its wearer into whatever job it says. A boy wore HEAD CHEF and now cooks all the school dinners.
x_badge.lore.legendary: Was pinned on a goat by mistake, and the goat was made head teacher. Exam results are up and the lawn is very short.

x_ballet_flat.lore.rare: Spins its wearer whenever music plays. Grandma got stuck at the supermarket till for a whole song.
x_ballet_flat.lore.epic: Spun so fast on stage that it drilled straight through the floor. The rest of the ballet happened in the basement.
x_ballet_flat.lore.legendary: Danced so lightly that it crossed the lake without touching the water. The swans have asked for lessons.

x_bathrobe.lore.epic: Puffed up so fluffy that it filled the whole hallway. The family has climbed over it to reach the kitchen all week.
x_bathrobe.lore.legendary: Has spent so many lazy mornings in the kitchen that it makes breakfast by itself. The toast is always a little fluffy.

x_belt.lore.rare: Snaps like a whip whenever someone reaches for the last chip. Nobody in the house has had a last chip in years.
x_belt.lore.epic: Slid off and lay in the garden pretending to be a snake. The whole street is still waiting at the window for the zoo.
x_belt.lore.legendary: Wrapped round the leaning tower one night and pulled it straight. The tower is now perfectly upright and a bit embarrassed.

x_bikini.lore.common: Twists its straps into a knot every time it goes into the beach bag.
x_bikini.lore.rare: Builds a sandcastle on the towel whenever nobody is looking. The seagulls have started queuing to visit.
x_bikini.lore.epic: Spiked a beach ball so hard that it bounced off the lighthouse. The boats now steer by the ball.
x_bikini.lore.legendary: Built a sandcastle so big at low tide that the sea could not get round it. The tide went home sulking.

x_brogue.lore.rare: Taps out messages through its little holes as it walks. It told the whole office who ate the last doughnut.
x_brogue.lore.epic: Clattered so loudly that every desk in the office clattered back. Nothing got done and the boss called it teamwork.
x_brogue.lore.legendary: Walked into the wrong office every day for a year and nobody noticed. It is now the manager.

x_cape.lore.epic: Flew its wearer off the shed and over every fence in the street, then got bored. He walked home from the next village.
x_cape.lore.legendary: Flew its wearer to the Moon and back before tea. He was still told off for not finishing his peas.

x_cardigan_sweater.lore.rare: Unravels at night and knits a tiny copy of itself. There are now nine cardigans and one confused granny.
x_cardigan_sweater.lore.epic: Unravelled at the family party until the living room was one big woolly web. Grandad is still stuck in the armchair.
x_cardigan_sweater.lore.legendary: Has been buttoned wrong for fifty years, so now the whole family buttons everything one hole down. Even the shop has started.

x_chelsea_boot.lore.uncommon: Stretches to fit anyone, so the whole family keeps borrowing it. It has not been home since Tuesday.
x_chelsea_boot.lore.rare: Snaps its elastic at anyone who steps on its toes. Nobody stands near it in the lift.
x_chelsea_boot.lore.epic: Strutted through a puddle so big that the high street flooded behind it. The shops sold umbrellas until midnight.
x_chelsea_boot.lore.legendary: Slipped off so easily that it went to a party without its owner. It came home at dawn with laces it did not need.

x_cleats.lore.common: Clacks on the kitchen tiles like a tap dancer, and the dog joins in.
x_cleats.lore.rare: Digs in so hard that it plants its owner like a tree. The coach had to lift him off the pitch with a spade.
x_cleats.lore.epic: Ran down the pitch so fast that it ploughed a row in the turf. The groundskeeper planted potatoes in it.
x_cleats.lore.legendary: Kicked a ball so high that it came down at the first match of next season. The referee counted it.

x_climbing_shoe.lore.rare: Climbs anything it sees, with or without you. It has been found on the fridge, the bookcase and the cat.
x_climbing_shoe.lore.epic: Climbed the outside of a block of flats to fetch a lost balloon. Every floor handed it a cup of tea on the way up.
x_climbing_shoe.lore.legendary: Climbed the tallest cliff in the country upside down. At the top it found a sign: LIFT OUT OF ORDER.

x_cloak.lore.rare: Makes its wearer invisible, but only to their little brother. He has been looking for her since spring.
x_cloak.lore.epic: Swirled so hard in the forest that every leaf blew off the trees. Autumn arrived two weeks early.
x_cloak.lore.legendary: Pulled its hood up so fast that it hid a whole mountain from a storm. The storm walked past and soaked the next valley.

x_clog_shoe.lore.uncommon: Floats in every puddle like a little boat, and the ducks keep climbing in.
x_clog_shoe.lore.rare: Kicks off so hard that it flies into next door's garden. The neighbours now return it with a cake each time.
x_clog_shoe.lore.epic: Clomped so loudly on the cobbles that every tulip in the field opened up. The bees have never worked so hard.
x_clog_shoe.lore.legendary: Clomped so hard in one dance that it rang the town bell from the square. Everyone came for lunch at ten in the morning.

x_costume.lore.legendary: Turned its wearer into such a good dragon that the fire brigade came round. They stayed for cake.

x_croc.lore.epic: Squeaked so loudly in the garden that every slug packed up and left. Next door's lettuces are now very crowded.
x_croc.lore.legendary: Floated down the river after a flood and became a boat for a family of frogs. They now run river tours on Sundays.

x_crop_top.lore.uncommon: Makes its wearer clap along to every song, even the fire alarm.
x_crop_top.lore.rare: Glows in the dark so brightly that the school disco has turned off its lights for good.
x_crop_top.lore.epic: Danced so hard at the summer fair that the bouncy castle joined in. It bounced off down the road, still full of children.
x_crop_top.lore.legendary: Danced every night for a whole summer and taught the Moon to do the twist. The tides have been wobbly ever since.

x_derby_shoe.lore.rare: Squeaks the answer to every test question, but always one question late.
x_derby_shoe.lore.epic: Marched into assembly so loudly that the head teacher forgot his speech. The school sang the dinner menu instead.
x_derby_shoe.lore.legendary: Walked to school so many years in a row that it now goes on its own, and the teacher marks it present.

x_dungarees.lore.epic: Dug up the whole allotment looking for one lost carrot. It found forty potatoes, a gnome, and the carrot in its own pocket.
x_dungarees.lore.legendary: Has so many pockets that a whole vegetable patch grew in them. Tomatoes come up through the bib every August.

x_espadrille.lore.rare: Unravels its rope sole to lasso anything it wants. So far it has caught a hat, a kite and a runaway beach ball.
x_espadrille.lore.epic: Unwound its rope sole so far that it tied every boat in the harbour together. The fishing fleet went out as one big raft.
x_espadrille.lore.legendary: Was mistaken for a rope and used to tie up a ship all summer. The ship is still there, and so is the shoe.

x_fleece.lore.rare: Collects every leaf, twig and burr on a walk and brings them indoors. Its owner came home wearing half a hedge.
x_fleece.lore.epic: Built up so much static on the school trip that every child's hair stood on end. The class photo looks like a field of dandelions.
x_fleece.lore.legendary: Sparked so much static on a mountain that it lit the hut lamps for a whole winter. The hikers rub it before dinner.

x_flip_flop.lore.rare: Slaps out a rhythm so catchy that strangers follow it down the beach. It once led a conga line into the sea.
x_flip_flop.lore.epic: Flew off a foot at the top of the water slide and went down alone. It finished first and refused to get out of the pool.
x_flip_flop.lore.legendary: Lost its partner in the sea and swam after it across the whole ocean. They met on a beach in another country and stayed for the summer.

x_football_boot.lore.common: Kicks a ball against the garage door every evening until the whole street knows the score.
x_football_boot.lore.epic: Kicked the ball so hard that it went round the world and hit the goalkeeper from behind. The goal still counts.
x_football_boot.lore.legendary: Scored a thousand goals in one long career, all from the bench. Nobody has worked out how.

x_high_heel.lore.rare: Makes its wearer taller every hour of the party. By midnight she was looking down on the chandelier.
x_high_heel.lore.epic: Clacked across the town square so loudly that every pigeon took off at once. The statue was clean for the first time in years.
x_high_heel.lore.legendary: Made its wearer so tall at the harbour ball that ships took her for the lighthouse. Two of them steered over to say hello.

x_hiking_shoe.lore.rare: Always knows the way home, but only the long way. Its owner has now seen every hill in the county twice.
x_hiking_shoe.lore.epic: Stomped up the same hill so often that it wore the top flat. The hill is now a very popular picnic table.
x_hiking_shoe.lore.legendary: Climbed every peak in the country, then the shed roof, because it was there. Grandad still cannot get it down.

x_ice_skate.lore.epic: Spun so fast on the frozen pond that it drilled a hole and a fish popped out. The fish now takes skating lessons.
x_ice_skate.lore.legendary: Skated across a lake so fast that the water froze just in front of it. It reached the far side in July.

x_jumpsuit.lore.uncommon: Zips up from toes to chin so fast that it once zipped the cat in too.
x_jumpsuit.lore.rare: Zips up anyone who stands still for too long. The dog, the cat and the hoover now wear matching suits.
x_jumpsuit.lore.epic: Zipped up so fast in the hangar that it shot its wearer into the sky. He landed on the runway like a very small plane.
x_jumpsuit.lore.legendary: Flew a plane across the ocean when the pilot nodded off. It landed perfectly and asked for more peanuts.

x_kilt.lore.common: Catches every thistle on the hill and brings it indoors to sit on.
x_kilt.lore.rare: Plays a little bagpipe tune whenever it swishes. The whole village knows when its owner sneaks to the fridge.
x_kilt.lore.epic: Danced a Highland fling so fast that it spun up a whirlwind. The bagpipes are still stuck up a tree in the next glen.
x_kilt.lore.legendary: Tossed a tree trunk so far that it landed on a castle and became its flagpole. The laird is delighted and slightly worried.

x_knee_high_boot.lore.uncommon: Hugs its wearer's legs so tightly that she waddles like a penguin.
x_knee_high_boot.lore.rare: Grows a little taller every time someone says it is too tall. It now reaches its owner's chin.
x_knee_high_boot.lore.epic: Kicked through the autumn leaves so hard that they filled the sky. The trees put them back on wrong.
x_knee_high_boot.lore.legendary: Strode across a river without wetting its owner, then a lake, then the sea. She went shopping in France.

x_lanyard.lore.common: Swings round and slaps you on the chin every time you run for the lift.
x_lanyard.lore.epic: Opened every door in the building at once. The office cat now has its own desk and a parking space.
x_lanyard.lore.legendary: Opened a door in the office that nobody knew was there. Behind it were all the pens anyone had ever lost.

x_leggings.lore.rare: Stretches so far that its owner can reach the remote from the sofa, and next door's remote too.
x_leggings.lore.epic: Stretched between two trees like a giant slingshot and launched a whole yoga class over the pond. They landed in perfect poses.
x_leggings.lore.legendary: Stretched from one bank of the river to the other and became a bridge. The ducks use it every morning.

x_mask_costume.lore.rare: Swaps faces with whoever looks at it. The head teacher spent a whole assembly as a tiger.
x_mask_costume.lore.epic: Made everyone at the masked ball forget who they were. They all went home to the wrong houses and nobody complained.
x_mask_costume.lore.legendary: Slipped into the grand ball without a ticket and danced all night with the mayor. He still has not noticed it was on a mop.

x_moccasin.lore.uncommon: Has beads stitched on top that the magpies keep trying to steal, one at a time, while it walks.
x_moccasin.lore.epic: Crept through the forest so quietly that the trees forgot it was there and fell asleep. Spring came a week late.
x_moccasin.lore.legendary: Has walked so softly for so long that it leaves no footprints at all. The snails have been trying to follow it for years.

x_mule.lore.rare: Kicks itself off under café tables and wanders. It has been found in the kitchen, the cellar and behind the till.
x_mule.lore.epic: Clacked across the terrace so loudly that the café chairs started dancing. Lunch was served on the move.
x_mule.lore.legendary: Was kicked off under a café table in Paris and walked home across the whole country. It arrived for breakfast, wanting croissants.

x_nightgown.lore.rare: Glows softly at midnight, so nobody in the house needs a night light. The moths have started visiting.
x_nightgown.lore.epic: Sleepwalked its wearer to the bus stop at midnight. She caught the first bus and got to work early, in her nightgown.
x_nightgown.lore.legendary: Floated off the landing one windy night and drifted over the town like a cloud. It rained gently on every allotment.

x_onesie.lore.epic: Made a whole sleepover feel so much like bears that they hibernated. They woke up in April asking for honey.
x_onesie.lore.legendary: Was so cosy that a real bear borrowed it for the winter. It came back washed, folded and smelling of honey.

x_overalls.lore.rare: Bounces mud straight back at whoever splashed it. The pigs have stopped trying.
x_overalls.lore.epic: Pitched so much hay at the barn dance that the barn filled to the roof. The band kept playing from inside a haystack.
x_overalls.lore.legendary: Worked the farm so long that the cows now follow it, not the farmer. He has to wear it to get the milk.

x_oxford_shoe.lore.epic: Strode across the stage at graduation so confidently that it was handed everyone's certificates. It is now the most qualified shoe in town.
x_oxford_shoe.lore.legendary: Was so smart that it was invited to the grand dinner without its owner. It sat at the top table and used the right fork.

x_pajamas.lore.rare: Makes every day a pyjama day for the whole house. The plumber came to fix the sink and stayed for cartoons.
x_pajamas.lore.epic: Was so comfy that the whole town stayed home in pyjamas on Monday. The mayor gave the news from bed.
x_pajamas.lore.legendary: Is so soft that clouds float down to touch it. The garden is foggy every morning and very comfy.

x_parka.lore.uncommon: Has a hood so deep that you can only see out through a tiny tunnel of fur.
x_parka.lore.rare: Pulls its hood shut whenever someone says something boring. Maths lessons are now very quiet.
x_parka.lore.epic: Was so warm on the snowy school trip that a whole fox family moved in. The class came home with five extra pupils.
x_parka.lore.legendary: Kept its owner so warm at the North Pole that the ice melted round him. He now has a private swimming pool.

x_platform_shoe.names.legendary: Madame Platforma of the Lamp Posts
x_platform_shoe.lore.epic: Stomped so hard at the disco that the glitter ball fell and rolled down the high street. The town danced after it until dawn.
x_platform_shoe.lore.legendary: Grew so tall that its wearer now changes the street-lamp bulbs by hand. The council has offered her a job.

x_poncho.lore.rare: Turns into a tent at the first drop of rain, whether its wearer is ready or not. He spent a whole bus ride camping.
x_poncho.lore.epic: Caught a gust on the mountain and glided its wearer down to the village like a paraglider. He arrived in time for lunch.
x_poncho.lore.legendary: Spread out so wide in a storm that it kept a whole herd of llamas dry. The llamas now refuse to go out without it.

x_puffer_jacket.lore.rare: Squashes into a tiny bag, then puffs back to full size wherever it likes. It burst a lunchbox open on the school bus.
x_puffer_jacket.lore.epic: Puffed up so much on the ski lift that it wedged itself between two chairs. Everyone had lunch dangling in the air.
x_puffer_jacket.lore.legendary: Puffed up so big on a cold night that it floated off like a hot-air balloon. Its owner enjoyed the view and landed for breakfast.

x_pump_shoe.lore.uncommon: Taps its heels whenever it hears a waltz, even on the bus, even at the dentist.
x_pump_shoe.lore.rare: Drags its wearer into a dance with whoever is nearest. She has waltzed with a waiter, a doorman and a hat stand.
x_pump_shoe.lore.epic: Spun so fast in the ballroom that the chandelier spun with it. The guests danced in circles until breakfast.
x_pump_shoe.lore.legendary: Danced through the whole night of the ball and kept going for a week. The band took turns to sleep.

x_raincoat_jacket.lore.legendary: Stretched over the whole bus stop in a storm and kept the queue dry. The driver refused to leave without it.

x_ribbon.lore.rare: Flutters so prettily that sparrows follow it home. Eleven of them now live in the hair-tie drawer.
x_ribbon.lore.legendary: Lassoed a runaway hot-air balloon at the village fair with one loop. The balloon now goes for walks on a lead, like a dog.

x_robe.lore.common: Hangs on the back of the door at night and looks exactly like a sleepy uncle.
x_robe.lore.uncommon: Always has one cold teabag in its pocket, and nobody knows how it gets there.
x_robe.lore.epic: Got so fluffy in the hotel tumble dryer that it filled the laundry room. The staff dug their way out with coat hangers.
x_robe.lore.legendary: Was so comfortable that its owner wore it to his own wedding. The bride wore one too, and they matched.

x_roller_shoe.lore.rare: Rolls off downhill whenever its wearer stops to tie a lace. She has reached the bottom of every hill in town by accident.
x_roller_shoe.lore.epic: Swerved through the shopping centre so fast that every escalator started running backwards. Shoppers ended up where they began.
x_roller_shoe.lore.legendary: Rolled through the airport so fast that it got to the next country before its plane. It was waiting at arrivals with a sign.

x_sandal_pair.lore.rare: Leaves a sandal-shaped tan that lasts all year. Its owner looks as if he wears them in the bath.
x_sandal_pair.lore.epic: Squelched so loudly along the seafront that the seagulls stopped stealing chips to listen. The chip shop had its best day ever.
x_sandal_pair.lore.legendary: Walked the seafront for so many summers that the sand now follows it home. The front garden has become a beach.

x_sari.lore.uncommon: Lets its long end flutter behind like a flag, and every small child in the room tries to catch it.
x_sari.lore.rare: Has a border that changes colour with its wearer's mood. Everyone at dinner knew Auntie wanted more pudding.
x_sari.lore.epic: Swirled so wide at the wedding dance that it swept every guest onto the floor. Even the cake ended up dancing.
x_sari.lore.legendary: Was so long that it became a sail and carried a whole wedding party across the river. For once, everyone arrived on time.

x_shoe_horn.lore.uncommon: Has such a long handle that everyone uses it to switch off the light from bed.
x_shoe_horn.lore.epic: Slid a foot into a boot so fast that the boot shot across the shop and out of the window. Sales doubled.
x_shoe_horn.lore.legendary: Helped a giant into a shoe the size of a boat. The giant was so pleased that he moved his family into it.

x_shoe_tree.lore.rare: Stretches any shoe it sits in. Dad's old trainers are now big enough for the dog to sleep in.
x_shoe_tree.lore.epic: Sprouted leaves in the wardrobe and grew into a real tree. The shoes now hang from its branches like fruit.
x_shoe_tree.lore.legendary: Kept a pair of boots in such perfect shape that they got bored and walked off on their own. They still send postcards.

x_shoelace.lore.epic: Tied the laces of the whole lunch queue together. The school walked to lunch like one long caterpillar.
x_shoelace.lore.legendary: Tied a knot so perfect that sailors come from far away to look at it. Nobody dares untie it, so the shoe has not moved in years.

x_ski_boot.lore.rare: Clamps on so tight that its wearer cannot take it off until spring. He went to school in it all term.
x_ski_boot.lore.epic: Clomped across the lodge so heavily that all the snow slid off the roof at once. The lodge vanished until teatime.
x_ski_boot.lore.legendary: Skied straight off the top of the mountain and landed in the valley pool. It now does ski jumps for the swimmers.

x_slipper_shoe.lore.rare: Steers its owner's feet wherever it fancies. Grandad set off for the kitchen and arrived in the garden shed.
x_slipper_shoe.lore.epic: Shuffled across the carpet so fast that it made enough static to light the whole house. The electricity bill has never been lower.
x_slipper_shoe.lore.legendary: Kept grandad's feet so warm that he walked to the shop through the snow in it. The snow melted in a path behind him.

x_snow_boot.lore.rare: Leaves footprints so big that people think a yeti has visited. The town now holds a yeti festival every winter.
x_snow_boot.lore.epic: Stamped off the snow so hard at the school door that it set off an avalanche in the playground. Everyone got the day off to dig.
x_snow_boot.lore.legendary: Walked all the way to the North Pole to post one letter. The letter got there first.

x_spikes_shoe.lore.epic: Ran round the track so fast that it lapped itself and tripped over its own footprints. Sports day had to start again.
x_spikes_shoe.lore.legendary: Ran the hundred metres so fast that it finished before the race was announced. It is still waiting for the others.

x_stiletto.lore.rare: Pins down anything that tries to blow away. The picnic has never been safer, but the kite has not flown in years.
x_stiletto.lore.epic: Strutted down the runway so sharply that it popped every balloon at the show. The photographers thought it was fireworks.
x_stiletto.lore.legendary: Walked a tightrope across the town square on one heel. The circus has asked it to stop showing off.

x_stockings.lore.rare: Snaps back like a catapult when it is pulled. It fired a pea right across the dinner table.
x_stockings.lore.epic: Stretched across the whole garden and became a washing line. The neighbours have started pegging their socks on it.
x_stockings.lore.legendary: Ran so many ladders in one night that a family of mice used them to climb the pantry shelf. They now live behind the jam.

x_suspenders.names.legendary: Sir Braceworth of the Big Top
x_suspenders.lore.epic: Pinged its owner so high at the barn dance that he landed in the hayloft. He watched the rest of the dance from up there.
x_suspenders.lore.legendary: Pinged a clown clean over the big top. He landed in the ringmaster's chair, and the circus has been his ever since.

x_swim_trunks.lore.rare: Floats its wearer like a duck, so he can never dive under. The other swimmers use him as a buoy.
x_swim_trunks.lore.epic: Jumped into the lake so hard that all the water jumped out. The fish waited on the bank while it filled back up.
x_swim_trunks.lore.legendary: Swam across the lake so fast that its wearer came out dry on the other side. The towel feels very unwanted.

x_swimsuit.lore.rare: Changes colour to match the pool, so nobody can find its wearer at home time.
x_swimsuit.lore.epic: Splashed in so hard that the deep end swapped places with the shallow end. Nobody could touch the bottom anywhere.
x_swimsuit.lore.legendary: Swam up the river and back before breakfast, and the river had to sit down. It now only flows in the afternoons.

x_tank_top.lore.epic: Flapped its armholes so hard in the heatwave that it cooled the whole beach. The seagulls put on scarves.
x_tank_top.lore.legendary: Showed off its owner's arms so proudly that a mountain flexed back. Climbers say the bump on top is new.

x_tights.lore.common: Twists round as you walk, so the seam ends up running down your shin.
x_tights.lore.uncommon: Crackles with so much static that every balloon at the party sticks to its wearer.
x_tights.lore.rare: Stretches into a skipping rope for anyone who asks. The whole playground has a turn before lunch.
x_tights.lore.epic: Stretched across the stage as a tightrope in the school play. The cast walked it, and the wizard fell into the orchestra.
x_tights.lore.legendary: Was pulled on by an octopus at the aquarium, all eight legs at once. The octopus now refuses to go out without them.

x_tunic.lore.epic: Made a whole class believe they were knights. They stormed the school kitchen and captured the custard.
x_tunic.lore.legendary: Was mistaken for a real knight's tunic and put in the castle museum. It now gives the tours and tells all the jokes.

x_turtleneck.lore.epic: Pulled itself over its wearer's head in the middle of a lecture. The hall laughed so hard that the professor did the same.
x_turtleneck.lore.legendary: Swallowed its wearer's head so completely that he spent the winter inside. He read twelve books and came out a genius.

x_underwear.lore.rare: Turns the colour of whatever it is washed with. It has been every colour of the rainbow since Tuesday.
x_underwear.lore.epic: Blew off the washing line and landed on the head of the town statue. The council says it is now part of the statue.
x_underwear.lore.legendary: Stretched its elastic so far that it became the finish tape at the town race. The winner snapped it and it flew all the way home.

x_uniform.lore.rare: Makes anyone who wears it stand up straight and salute. Grandad saluted the fridge for a whole hour.
x_uniform.lore.epic: Ironed itself so stiffly that it marched to school without its owner. It got a gold star for good behaviour.
x_uniform.lore.legendary: Polished its buttons so brightly that the whole parade marched into its own reflection. The band is still saluting itself.

x_vest.lore.uncommon: Is so warm that its wearer refuses to take off his coat, his scarf or the vest, even in July.
x_vest.lore.rare: Holds in so much heat that its wearer can melt the frost off the car with a hug.
x_vest.lore.epic: Was so warm in the coldest week that the whole family lived in it together. Dad's head came out of the left armhole.
x_vest.lore.legendary: Kept its wearer so warm at the South Pole that the penguins queued to stand next to him.

x_wedge_shoe.names.legendary: Madame Corkwell of the Garden Party
x_wedge_shoe.lore.common: Leaves a trail of cork crumbs everywhere, so you can always find your way back to it.
x_wedge_shoe.lore.rare: Floats like a cork, so its wearer bobs straight back up whenever she tries to dive. She has tried eleven times.
x_wedge_shoe.lore.legendary: Bobbed out to sea after a garden party and came back a week later with a seagull captain. The seagull now comes to every party.

x_wetsuit.lore.rare: Is so slippery that it slides its wearer straight off every surfboard. The seals laugh every single time.
x_wetsuit.lore.epic: Squeaked so loudly going on that every dolphin in the bay came to look. Surf school became dolphin watching.
x_wetsuit.lore.legendary: Rode a wave so big that it surfed into next week. It came home sunburnt, with a postcard from Thursday.

x_windbreaker.lore.uncommon: Fills up with wind like a balloon and makes its wearer walk on tiptoe.
x_windbreaker.lore.epic: Caught a gust on the beach and lifted its wearer like a kite. He waved to the gulls and landed on the pier for lunch.
x_windbreaker.lore.legendary: Stood in the way of a gale on the cliff top. The wind said sorry and went the long way round.
